name: CustomBooks (formerly AccountingSuite)
description_en:
CustomBooks is the current name of the accounting and inventory service previously called AccountingSuite. The old official homepage and pricing URL redirect to custombooks.com, and the current end-user agreement explicitly identifies AccountingSuite as the former trade name.

Its scope includes accounting, banking, sales, purchasing and optional inventory/ecommerce workflows. Plan selection depends on the work an organization performs, while organizations and add-on services affect the bill. The original catalog slug is retained for continuity; no trial, import or inventory movement was executed.
description_zh:
CustomBooks 是原 AccountingSuite 会计与库存服务的现名称。原官方首页和定价地址已跳转到 custombooks.com，现行终端用户协议明确把 AccountingSuite 列为旧商号。

它涵盖会计、银行、销售、采购，以及按套餐提供的库存和电商流程。套餐选择取决于企业实际工作，组织数及附加服务也会影响账单。本档案保留原目录 slug 以维持连续性；未实际执行试用、导入或库存移动。

core_features.explanation_en: Business Edition lists journals, banking, sales and purchase documents with project/time tracking.
core_features.explanation_zh: Business Edition 列出日记账、银行、销售采购单据及项目工时跟踪。

core_features.explanation_en: With multi-location enabled, record transfers and supporting attachments between locations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 启用多地点设置后，可记录地点间调拨及其附件。

core_features.explanation_en: Inventory capabilities include assemblies/disassembly, bills of materials and FIFO or weighted-average costing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 库存能力包括组装与拆解、物料清单，以及先进先出或加权平均计价。

pricing.billing_basis: Per organization and edition, with separate service/usage costs; dollar-denominated display, ISO currency code not independently established.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Business $109/month or $1,199/year; Professional $299/month or $3,199/year; eCommerce $399/month or $4,299/year. Additional services and exclusions apply.

sections.en:
The migration is supported by more than a similar logo: both old official URLs redirect to the current service, and definition 1.4 of the end-user agreement says AccountingSuite was the former trade name. The service identifies Yellow Labs Software, Inc. doing business as CustomBooks. Retaining the existing record avoids creating two profiles for one renamed product.

Do not combine this with a similarly named AccountingSuite service on another regional domain without a separate identity check. Old directory prices and an old Webflow preview are not current commercial authority. Use the live CustomBooks pages for this record’s capabilities and billing conditions.
sections.zh:
迁移依据不只是相似标识：原官方首页和定价链接均跳转至现服务，终端用户协议第 1.4 项明确说明 AccountingSuite 是旧商号。服务主体标为 Yellow Labs Software, Inc.，使用 CustomBooks 商号。保留原记录可以避免为同一更名产品建立两份档案。

不能未经身份核对，就与其他地区域名上同名 AccountingSuite 服务合并。旧目录价格和旧 Webflow 预览站不能作为现行商业条件权威；本档案采用当前 CustomBooks 页面。

sections.title_en: Connect purchasing, inventory and customer sales
sections.title_zh: 连接采购、库存与客户销售
sections.en:
The inventory page describes items reused across quotations, invoices, purchase orders and bills. A hypothetical distributor can start with a purchase order, receive stock, sell an item and inspect its shipment and accounting records. Multi-location transfers require that capability to be enabled in the account; a location label alone does not establish the stock moved correctly.

Check the received quantity, unit conversion, tax and remaining stock against the associated financial documents. The product describes landed costs allocated at receipt or bill and supports FIFO and weighted-average costing. Those choices should be agreed before migration because an item count and its accounting value answer different questions.
sections.zh:
库存页面介绍报价、发票、采购订单和账单复用物品资料。以假设的分销商为例，可从采购订单开始，接收入库，再销售物品，并检查发运及会计记录。跨地点调拨需要在账户中启用相关能力；有地点标签并不能证明库存移动正确。

应把收货数量、计量单位换算、税项和剩余库存与关联财务单据对照。产品说明可在收货或账单时分摊到岸成本，并支持先进先出与加权平均计价。迁移前应商定这些选择，因为实物数量与会计价值回答的是不同问题。

sections.title_en: Assemblies are more specific than an inventory checkbox
sections.title_zh: 组装功能需要具体核对
sections.en:
CustomBooks describes an assembly as component items used to make another item, with component quantities maintained through a bill of materials. It also lists disassembly and consignment locations. A useful evaluation is a small kit made from two components: inspect component depletion, finished-item availability and the resulting cost.

That example is proposed, not tested. These descriptions do not establish production scheduling, regulated manufacturing validation or every warehouse method. The inventory page’s lot/serial heading has text about Cloud Commerce instead of a detailed tracking explanation; the pricing matrix separately lists lots and serial numbers, so detailed traceability behavior still needs a demonstration.
sections.zh:
CustomBooks 将组装定义为用组件物品形成另一个物品，并通过物料清单维护组件数量；还列出拆解及寄售地点。可用由两个组件组成的小套件评估，检查组件扣减、成品可用量和形成的成本。

这只是建议样例，未实际测试。这些说明不能证明生产排程、受监管制造验证或所有仓储方式均已覆盖。库存页的批次／序列号标题下正文却在介绍 Cloud Commerce；定价表另外列出批次和序列号，因此详细追溯行为仍需演示核对。

sections.title_en: Price the organization and edition, then the extras
sections.title_zh: 先看组织与版本，再算附加项
sections.en:
The current pricing page lists Business at $109 monthly or $1,199 yearly, Professional at $299 monthly or $3,199 yearly, and Professional with eCommerce at $399 monthly or $4,299 yearly. Its comparison also lists Start-up at $29 monthly or $329 yearly. These are displayed dollar amounts; the page text read did not independently establish a currency code. Annual totals are not monthly payment prices.

Organizations are charged separately, even though the editions advertise unlimited users. Inventory is shown with Professional and commerce with the eCommerce edition. AvaTax integration does not include an AvaTax subscription. Payroll usage, chargeable bank feeds, additional storage and migration may add costs. Do not treat a temporary six-month discount as the renewal rate.
sections.zh:
当前定价页列出 Business 月付 $109或年付 1,199，Professional 月付 299 或年付 3,199，Professional with eCommerce 月付 399 或年付 4,299；对照表还列出 Start-up 月付 29 或年付 329。页面以 $ 显示金额，本次读取文本未独立确立币种代码，不能把年费当作月付价格。

即使版本宣传不限用户，组织仍分别收费。Professional 对应库存，电商版本对应 commerce；集成 AvaTax 并不包含其订阅。薪资用量、收费银行数据源、额外存储和迁移可能另计费用；临时六个月折扣不能当成续费价。

sections.title_en: Import tools need a controlled accounting cutover
sections.title_zh: 导入工具仍需要受控的账务切换
sections.en:
The getting-started page introduces the setup wizard, module settings, a data import wizard supporting .xlsx, .txt, .csv and .iif files, bank connections and user profiles. Prepare the chart, opening balances, contacts, item units and tax treatment before importing transactions. The advertised 30-day trial gives time to inspect these workflows; it is not an ongoing free plan.

A suggested acceptance set includes a normal sale, credit/return, transfer, duplicate input and a period-end report. Compare totals with the prior system and check which historical data the migration service actually converts. Unlimited users should still receive restricted roles; it does not mean each user should see payroll or all accounting modules.
sections.zh:
入门页介绍设置向导、模块设置、支持 .xlsx、.txt、.csv 和 .iif 的导入向导、银行连接及用户资料。导入交易前，应准备科目、期初余额、联系人、物品单位和税务处理。宣传的 30 天试用可用于检查这些流程，不是持续免费套餐。

建议验收普通销售、贷项／退货、调拨、重复输入及期末报表，并与旧系统总额对照，明确迁移服务究竟转换哪些历史资料。不限用户仍应配置受限角色，不意味着每个人都应看到薪资或全部会计模块。

sections.title_zh: 托管定制仍受合同限制
sections.en:
The agreement grants a limited, revocable right to use the service and separately addresses customizations and third-party components. The current product is a hosted commercial service; this record does not label it open source or infer a right to redistribute it. Custom development and a public API need their own implementation scope.

The best fit is an organization that wants accounting tied to stock and business documents and can validate its configuration. A simple invoice-only user may not need that breadth. Before committing, obtain cancellation/export terms and a recovery demonstration for your setup. Marketing backup claims were not independently tested, and access to a hosted system does not demonstrate restore success.
sections.zh:
协议授予有限、可撤销的服务使用权，并另行涉及定制和第三方组件。当前产品属于托管商业服务，本档案不将其标为开源，也不推定可以再分发。定制开发和公开 API 需要各自明确实施范围。

适合优先评估的是希望把会计、库存和业务单据连接起来、又能验收配置的组织。只需简单发票的用户可能用不到这个范围。采用前应取得取消与导出条件，并针对实际配置演示恢复；营销中的备份主张未经独立测试，能访问托管系统不等于恢复成功。
